title: HYPERION. Interacting companion and outflow in the most luminous z > 6 quasar
question: Does deep, lower-resolution ALMA band 3 and 6 data of the z>6 quasar J0100+2802 reveal an interacting companion and a [CII] outflow, and what are their properties?

data.angular_resolution: B6 cube beam 1.08x0.82 arcsec; B3 continuum 2.59x1.95 arcsec
data.sensitivity: B6 continuum 0.01 mJy/beam, cube 0.2 mJy/beam per 9 km/s channel; B3 continuum 5 uJy/beam

what.value: QSO dust properties (Tdust 48 K, Mdust 2.3e7 Msun, beta 2.6) and SFR 265 Msun/yr

evidence.quote: The dust properties and SFR of the QSO host galaxy are taken from (cite: tripodi2023b).
we adopted the bolometric luminosity of $L_{\rm bol}= 4.29\times10^{14}\rm L_{\odot}$ estimated by (cite: wu2015)

what.value: Dust mass absorption coefficient k0=0.45 cm2/g at 250 GHz

evidence.quote: $k_0 = 0.45\  \rm cm^{2}\ g^{-1}$ the mass absorption coefficient (cite: beelen+2006)
the molecular gas mass of $5.4\times 10^9\ \rm M_\odot$ found by (cite: wang2019)

recipe.method: tclean natural weighting; MFS continuum in line-free channels; uvcontsub order 0 for cube

recipe.goal: Measure fluxes of QSO and companion
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits and PSF subtraction normalized to QSO peak; flux in S/N>2 regions with RA offset <-1.3 arcsec
assumptions: All elongated S/N>2 features attributed to a single companion

recipe.method: Modified black body with CMB correction; Mdust free, Tdust fixed to 50 K or 30 K, beta scanned 1-3 in steps of 0.1
key_parameters: 20 chains, 1000 trials per beta; uniform prior 1e4-1e12 Msun
assumptions: k0=0.45 cm2/g at 250 GHz; source area ~4.0 arcsec2

recipe.method: Integrate best-fit models 8-1000 um; Kennicutt 1998 with Chabrier IMF
Single Gaussian then two-Gaussian MCMC fit (6 free parameters) of spectrum from ~1.2 arcsec radius aperture
key_parameters: uniform priors; narrow and broad mean frequencies not overlapping

recipe.method: M_HI from Hailey-Dunsheath relation; Mdot = v M/R; kinetic power and momentum load vs L_bol/c

evidence.quote: This implies an SFR in the range $[35-344]\ \rm M_{\odot}\ yr^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Cell size, image size, clean mask and iteration/threshold values
Which MFS/line channels were combined exactly for continuum and moment maps
X_C+, gas temperature and density used in the HI mass equation
Outflow radius derivation details and L_out computation
Priors/initial values of the two-Gaussian MCMC
Exact PSF subtraction procedure and apertures
Whether the second project 2021.2.00151.S data was used
missing_for_reproduction: Exact regions and PSF subtraction details
score_reason: Public data and broad method outlined, but many imaging and energetics parameters unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Data from ALMA project likely public; numeric fluxes and fit results can be compared, though some settings missing.
